findings.where: all links (nav, hero CTAs, CTA band)
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: all 10 links have href="#". 'Product', 'Pricing', 'Docs', 'Watch demo' and both trial links go nowhere; activating them only jumps to the top of the page.
findings.after: Pricing; for 'Watch demo' a
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context): the accessible name promises a destination the link does not have.

findings.where: logo strip (div.logos-inner), h1 caret, logo dot
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: logo-marquee 12s animation on the logo strip, blink-cursor 0.9s on span.fake-cursor in the h1 and pulse-status 1.8s on the logo dot, all running continuously; no pause control is visible in the tiles.
findings.before: Infinite marquee and blinking caret with no pause
findings.after: Add a pause button for the marquee (or make it static), and set animation: none on .fake-cursor and .logo-dot; also wrap all three in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide: moving content that lasts more than 5 seconds and runs alongside other content needs a way to stop it.

findings.evidence: landmarks: main 0, header 0, nav 1, footer 1; first focusable is 'Product' (no skip link). Sections are bare <section> elements under <body>.

findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships and 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks (sweep flagged no <main>; skip link and header are the added part).

findings.evidence: Card icons are emoji in div.icon ('⚡', '🔒', '📈') with no aria-hidden, so screen readers announce 'high voltage', 'locked', 'chart increasing' before each heading.
findings.after:
⚡
(or replace with an svg icon marked aria-hidden)
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content: decorative symbols should be hidden from assistive tech.
